scope: Detection request budgets, attempt-level usage evidence, bounded rate-limit retries, cancellation, and unknown-cost handling

red_evidence.reason: the request-budget and detector-retry modules were absent

assertions: insufficient or uncertain budget blocks before a provider request
HTTP 429 permits at most two retries and honors the supplied retry delay
cancellation prevents a new request while retaining already incurred usage
every attempt binds the request identity, response status, and known or unknown usage
unknown network usage remains unknown rather than being recorded as zero

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy

live_blocker: No live rate-limit, billing, or usage response was observed, so provider-specific cost semantics remain unverified.
